timelineEntry.contract: A fresh task starts at the supplied timeline time. Its first evaluation begins non-single-frame actions spanning that time and supplies currentTime minus actionStart as elapsed time. Earlier single-frame actions are skipped. The old task ends through its normal lifecycle.

nativeBlueprintUses: SlitheringSword_C reads CurrentTime and starts Perfect at the same time
ChiZheCanJian_DrinkBase reads Timeline and starts that timeline at JumpEndTime
ShuangYue starts Enhanced at nonzero 0.2 or 0.35

bronzeFinalWave.activeBooleanMeaning: UltimateChargeCount >= max(Ultimate Charge Cost, 1); normal activation consumes the charge and installs the normal endure effect and same-timeline tag; false selects Failed
bronzeFinalWave.qualification: Wait on the actual active Main task's timeline clock after native activation; do not use wall-clock delay or change task time fields. Do not rewind a task already beyond the desired entry time.
